name: What Fish Are For
description: Food, ore fish, gear and fish with odd effects.

pages.title: What Fish Are For
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Cook any fish on a campfire, smoker or furnace.
- **Ore fish** craft into raw iron, raw gold, lapis and amethyst.
- Some fish become **gear**: swords, a bow, boots.
- A few fish have **effects** when eaten.

Tide fish cook into **Small**, plain or **Large Cooked Fish** depending on size. On a Farmer's Delight board a knife cuts any of them into 2 **raw fillets** and bone meal, the same fillets Aquaculture fish give.\
\
Meals: [#](2E5AAC)[Sea Food](entry://fishing/sea_food)[#]().

**Craft a fish into:**

- Iron Tetra: 2 raw iron. Gilded Minnow: 2 raw gold.
- Lapis Lanternfish: 2 lapis. Crystal Shrimp: 4 amethyst.
- Glowfish: 2 glow ink sacs.
- Enderfin: ender pearl. Endergazer: eye of ender. Elytrout: phantom membrane.

- Luminescent Jellyfish or Sun Emblem: 8 **Jelly Torches**, which burn underwater.
- Incandescent Larva and Pale Clubfish: bait.

**Gear:** Sailfish, Swordfish and Blazing Swordfish are swords (the last sets things on fire). Shooting Starfish + bow: **Starlight Bow**. Dragon Fish + netherite boots: **Dragonfin Boots**, a jump in mid-air.

**Eaten:** lava fish give Fire Resistance; Uranias Pisces, 10 minutes of Luck; Ender Glider and Mantyvern, Slow Falling; Chorus Cod teleports you like chorus fruit.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** Witherfin gives Wither. Several Hybrid Aquatic fish poison you raw.
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** The **Chasm Eel** can't eat through bedrock. Cats eat cookable fish. Tide's Fish Slices are replaced by Aquaculture's fillets.
